newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. speaker says gov rent rule plan 'nothing new'.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. speaker says gov rent rule plan 'nothing new'.

text.p: The New York State Assembly Speaker on Monday wasted no time attacking a new rent control plan Gov. George Pataki proposed, saying what the governor billed as a compromise failed to break ground.

Sheldon Silver, D-Manhattan, who accused the Republican governor of siding with landlords in the heated battle over apartment rent rules, said: "I think it's clear the side the governor came down on. He goes for vacancy decontrol. So there's nothing new."
